preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, list) for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: Each row in the matrix is a list.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(char, str) and len(char) == 1 and 'a' <= char <= 'z' for row in matrix for char in row)
preconditions.description: Each element in the matrix is a single lowercase alphabetical character.
The number of rows in the matrix is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) >= 1 and len(row) <= 100 for row in matrix)
preconditions.description: The number of columns in each row is between 1 and 100.

postconditions.description: The returned value is a non-negative integer less than 10^9 + 7.
The returned value is the count of palindromic paths from the top-left to the bottom-right cell modulo 10^9 + 7.
